d: Hailed as the "Plastic Man of India," Mr. Rajagopalan Vasudevan is a chemistry professor who has ingeniously addressed the burgeoning issue of plastic waste in India. Through relentless research and experimentation, Mr. Rajagopalan pioneered a revolutionary method that incorporates various forms of plastic waste, including bottles and wrappers, into road construction. This ground-breaking innovation not only provides an eco-friendly solution to plastic waste management but also significantly enhances the quality of the roads.
